content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 12 vacancies are available – 1 for Chief Executive Officer (CEO), 1 for Sr. Project Engineer, 1 for System Administrator, 2 for Project Engineer (Technical), 1 for Project Scientist, 1 for Project Engineer (Skilling), 1 for Assistant Project Scientist, 2 for Associate Project Engineer, and 2 for Sr. Project Technician.

content_sections.text: Chief Executive Officer (CEO): Master's degree in Engineering/Science; Master's in Engineering/Management or equivalent preferred. Over 12 years of relevant experience, including 9+ years in leadership roles within start-ups, venture investment, corporate innovation, or technology scaling. Sr. Project Engineer: M.Tech in Electronics and Communication (EC) Engineering or Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 10 years of experience. System Administrator: M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 03 years of relevant experience, OR B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 06 years of relevant experience. Project Engineer (Technical): M.Tech in Electronics and Communication (EC) Engineering or Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 06 years of experience. Project Scientist: Bachelor's degree in Arts/Science/Humanities with 09 years of experience. Project Engineer (Skilling): B.Tech in Electronics and Communication (EC) Engineering or Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 08 years of experience. Assistant Project Scientist: Bachelor's degree in Arts/Science/Humanities with 08 years of experience. Associate Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication (EC) Engineering or Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) with 02 years of experience. Sr. Project Technician: B.Sc with 08 years of experience OR ITI/Diploma in Engineering/B.A with 10 years of experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Project Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions is 12th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for Project Staff positions announced by IIT Guwahati. These positions are spread across various roles as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Guwahati Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for IIT Guwahati Project Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati will primarily be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati ranges from Rs. 23,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per month, depending on the specific post and the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed duration as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary significantly by post, ranging from a Bachelor's degree in Arts/Science/Humanities to M.Tech in specialized engineering fields, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a general age limit for all posts. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for age criteria specific to each position.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions must be submitted online only. The walk-in interview date is mentioned, but the application process is online.
